command:
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import unittest

class GateFixture(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_independent_approval_at_exact_base(self):
        self.assertTrue(Path("scripts/check-java-submission.py").is_file(), "The base does not run an independent Java approval check")
        result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-B", "-X", "utf8", "-m", "unittest", "discover",
                                 "-s", "scripts/tests", "-p", "test_java_submission.py"],
                                capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8", timeout=130)
        self.assertEqual(0, result.returncode, result.stdout + result.stderr)

suite = unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromTestCase(GateFixture)
names = [test.id() for test in suite]
result = unittest.TextTestRunner().run(suite)
Path(sys.argv[1]).write_text(json.dumps({
    "runId": sys.argv[2], "tests": result.testsRun, "failures": len(result.failures), "errors": len(result.errors),
    "skipped": len(result.skipped), "names": names, "failedNames": [test.id() for test, _ in result.failures],
}), encoding="utf-8")
sys.exit(not result.wasSuccessful())

import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import unittest
sys.path.insert(0, "scripts/tests")
suite = unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromName('test_java_submission.JavaSubmissionTests.test_bootstrap_requires_complete_first_installation_and_is_not_reusable')
names = [test.id() for test in suite]
result = unittest.TextTestRunner().run(suite)
Path(sys.argv[1]).write_text(json.dumps({
    "runId": sys.argv[2], "tests": result.testsRun, "failures": len(result.failures),
    "errors": len(result.errors), "skipped": len(result.skipped), "names": names,
    "failedNames": [test.id() for test, _ in result.failures],
}), encoding="utf-8")
sys.exit(not result.wasSuccessful())
